sloka: यच्च तस्य महच्छूलं त्र्यम्बकेण महात्मना ।दत्तं शत्रुविनाशाय मधोरायुधमुत्तमम् ।। ७.६३.२५ ॥
transliteration: yacca tasya mahacchūlaṁ tryambakeṇa mahātmanā ।dattaṁ śatruvināśāya madhorāyudhamuttamam ।। 7.63.25 ॥

translations.english: And that great trident, Madhu's excellent weapon, was given to him by the great-souled Tryambaka (Shiva) for the destruction of enemies.
